description: `{{ expr }}` renders an expression as escaped text.
`[attr.name]="expr"` sets an HTML attribute that has no DOM property (ARIA, `colspan`). `null` removes it.
`[class.name]="bool"` toggles one class; `[class]="{ a: x, b: y }"` sets many. Replaces legacy `[ngClass]`.
`[style.width.px]="n"` sets one style with an optional unit; `[style]="{...}"` sets many. Replaces legacy `[ngStyle]`.
`#ref` exposes an element or directive instance to the rest of the template.
